bibleVerses.text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
bibleVerses.reflection: You are not asked to carry today alone. The Shepherd knows the way, even when you cannot see it.

bibleVerses.text: Be still, and know that I am God.
bibleVerses.reflection: Stillness is not giving up. It is remembering who holds the world, and who holds you.

bibleVerses.text: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
bibleVerses.reflection: Fear speaks loudly, but it does not get the final word. Light is still stronger.

bibleVerses.text: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
bibleVerses.reflection: Today is a gift, not a guarantee. Let us receive it with grateful hearts.

bibleVerses.text: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
bibleVerses.reflection: Understanding has limits. Trust reaches further than what we can figure out.

bibleVerses.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
bibleVerses.reflection: Rest is an invitation, not a reward. Bring your tired heart to Jesus today.

bibleVerses.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
bibleVerses.reflection: Love moved first. Before you had anything to offer, God loved you.

bibleVerses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
bibleVerses.reflection: Not everything that happens is good, but God is still at work in it. Nothing is wasted in His hands.

bibleVerses.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
bibleVerses.reflection: Strength here is not endless energy. It is Christ carrying you through what you cannot carry alone.

bibleVerses.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.
bibleVerses.reflection: You are not forgotten, and you are not alone. God is nearer than your fear.

bibleVerses.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
bibleVerses.reflection: You are allowed to put it down. God cares about the detail you think is too small.

bibleVerses.text: Let all your things be done with charity.
bibleVerses.reflection: Love is not only a feeling. It shows up in ordinary, faithful actions.

bibleVerses.text: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
bibleVerses.reflection: God is close to the brokenhearted. Your sorrow is not an inconvenience to Him.

bibleVerses.text: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
bibleVerses.reflection: The weight was never meant to be carried alone. Hand it over, one piece at a time.

bibleVerses.text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
bibleVerses.reflection: Waiting is not wasted time. Strength is being renewed in the waiting.

bibleVerses.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself.
bibleVerses.reflection: Tomorrow will ask for your attention soon enough. Let today have your whole heart.

bibleVerses.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
bibleVerses.reflection: The peace Jesus gives is not dependent on circumstances. It can hold you in the middle of them.

bibleVerses.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
bibleVerses.reflection: Hope, patience, prayer. Three small practices that carry a person a long way.

bibleVerses.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
bibleVerses.reflection: Faith is not certainty about the future. It is trust in the One who holds it.

bibleVerses.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
bibleVerses.reflection: Courage is not the absence of fear. It is moving forward because God goes with you.
